article.title: Is Data Center Resistance a New Vehicle for Multiracial Democracy?
article.author: Chandra Russo
article.content: When it comes to data centers, Americans are increasingly polling like a Dr. Seuss book. We would not like them here or there. We would not like them anywhere. Across partisan lines, politicians have gotten the message. Sure, Trump has called those who oppose data centers “backwards and poor.” Yet many other Republicans are warning that not taking a stronger stance against data centers will… Source
